card: Warm pool supervises its workers: respawn off the critical path, quarantine crash loops
deviations_from_card: Case 2 made deterministic per the critic: no wall-clock bounds. fake_warm gained FAKE_WARM_SPAWNS (atomic spawn-number files holding the pid), FAKE_WARM_FAIL_SPAWNS, FAKE_WARM_SLOW_SPAWNS, FAKE_WARM_LOAD_MS and FAKE_WARM_LOAD_GATE (load held until a file the test creates exists). The test asserts the replacement spawn file appears with no sentence asked for (respawn began at the death), that a sentence during the held load is answered by the live worker, and after the gate opens that the respawned pid renders. Case 4's 'within 1 s' is asserted as 'no reload attempted' (spawn count unchanged) plus the exact reason. Case 6's pid check is Popen.poll() after close (reaped) plus no voice-respawn-* thread alive. Backoff is a module constant RESPAWN_BACKOFF_S, patched to (0.0,) in test_warm setUp. One test-only fix after the red commit: case 2's 'z' text was lengthened because the splitter merged two short sentences. Contract commit is typed docs(...) (wording only).
notes: Full voice suite rc=1 only on tests.test_pool (test_lines_overlap_in_the_pool_and_go_out_in_order, test_the_pool_never_runs_more_than_its_workers) - process-engine timing tests that never touch warm.py; re-run once, still red; the same tests (plus test_cancel_mid_pool...) are red on an untouched git-archive export of base 94e5998 under the current machine load (sibling builds), so it is load, not this change. Every other voice test green (82 run, 1 skipped). The daemon's readiness substring 'engine: warm' is preserved ('engine: warm (2 of 3 workers loaded in ...)'). contract.md edited under the scan-sweep-challenge.lock, committed alone, lock removed. test_pool.py untouched.
